Proposed question: The mean mass of 9 backpacks is 15 kg.
The mean mass of four of the backpacks is 12 kg and the mean mass of three others is 20 kg. Find the mean mass of the remaining two backpacks.
Answers: $13.5\text{ kg}$; the remaining total is $9\times15-4\times12-3\times20=27$, so their mean is $27\div2=13.5$.
